title: Agent Handoff Contract
description: Defines preconditions, postconditions, and artifact schemas for agent-to-agent handoffs in PilotSuite multi-agent orchestration.

handoff_id.description: Unique identifier for this handoff. Format: {agent-from}-{agent-to}-{unix_ts_ms}

from_agent.description: Agent ID or role name handing off (e.g. 'hephaistos', 'pilotclaw', 'designclaw')

to_agent.description: Agent ID or role name receiving the task

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of handoff initiation

timeout_seconds.description: Max seconds the receiver has to acknowledge before escalation

preconditions.description: What must be true/available before the receiving agent should proceed

required_entities.description: HA entity IDs that must be available (e.g. ['sensor.pilotsuite_styx_version'])

required_state.description: Key-value pairs of entity_id → expected state for proceed

required_capabilities.description: Capability flags the receiver must advertise (e.g. ['github_write', 'ha_api'])

required_context.description: Context fields that must be non-null (e.g. ['user_id', 'ha_token'])

postconditions.description: What the receiving agent guarantees to produce or achieve

output_schema.description: JSON Schema for the artifact/output the receiver must deliver

output_location.description: Path or URL where output artifact will be written (e.g. 'team/repos/pilotsuite-styx-ha/PR.md')

side_effects.description: Description of any state changes the receiver will make (e.g. ['git commit', 'HA entity update'])

user_intent.description: Plain-language description of what the user asked for

prior_attempts.description: What previous agents already tried (to avoid redundant work)

memory_refs.description: MEMORY.md paths or snippets relevant to this task

user_id.description: Telegram user ID of requesting user

escalation_path.description: Ordered list of agents/roles to escalate to if receiver declines or times out

artifact_refs.description: Existing artifacts/files the receiver should build upon or reference
